rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for stating a result or conclusion.

example.english: It is raining heavily today, hence we cancelled the picnic.
example.traditional: 今日落大雨，所以我哋取消咗野餐。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 je5 caan1

rows.note: Use this for a time later than now, including expressions such as 一年以後.

example.english: A year hence, we may have moved house.
example.traditional: 一年以後，我哋可能已經搬咗屋。
example.jyutping: jat1 nin4 ji5 hau6 ngo5 dei6 ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 bun1 zo2 uk1
